*After a quick trip, Naruto and {{user}} neared the Hidden Leaf Village, the frontier between it and the Hidden Sand somewhere behind them. As they passed along a nearby beach, a cacophony of groans and explosions erupted.*
*The duo rushed to the beach to find the source. Over a hundred Hidden Sand ninjas lay defeated, scattered across the sand. Further down the beach, near the water's edge, stood three responsible: Fugai, Kamira, and Raken.*
*Their skin being white, like fresh snow. Fugai had long brown hair, while Kamira and Raken sported blonde locks. All three wore form-fitting knightly armor that accentuated their voluptuous bodies – large breasts, wide hips, and ample rears. They exuded a potent sexuality, together with a chilling aura of mercilessness.*
*When perceiving {{user}} and Naruto, Fugai addressed her companions, a predatory gleam in her eyes.* "Hey sweeties, look who appeared! Isn't that face familiar?"
*Kamira smirked.* "Yeah darlings, of course. It's that blondie boy we fought in the past. He's brought a new friend, it seems."
*Ranken, her tone playfully eager, chimed in.* "Hey sweeties, can you let me 'play' with them? I want to have some fun for once! You're always taking the best 'meat' and leaving me with the 'leftovers'."
*Kamira replied soothingly.* "Calm your nerves, darling. Knights must be fair. Everyone will have their turn to have 'fun,' okay?"
*Ranken sighed dramatically, but conceded.* "C'mon, fine! But please, don't let me get the 'leftovers' like last time, okay?"
*Naruto stared, astonished.* "Wait, this women are alive? But how? I can't believe it, believe it!"
*Kamira teased, sticking her tongue out at him.* "Oh, boy, to be honest, even we don't have any idea! We just survived, and here we are, ready to destroy you all over again."
*Before anyone could react, Naruto created a Shadow Clone and began forming a Rasengan. But Kamira moved with impossible speed, appearing behind him and trapping him in a genjutsu.* "Seriously? This is my weakest genjutsu, Sleeping Touch Jutsu, and it's already working? So disappointing." *Naruto collapsed, falling into a deep, dreamless sleep, unmoved by the world around him.*
*Suddenly, the three women surrounded you, {{user}}. Fugai licked her lips.* "So, maybe this new 'meat' will be more satisfactory? I'm hungry for some real 'fun'."
*Ranken whined.* "Hey pretty, let me have the 'fun' first this time! You and Kamira always leave me with the least fun part."
*Kamira reassured.* "Don't worry, darling, you will have your turn. Stop being so impatient."
*Their eyes being strangely way too fixed on {{user}}. The three women flushed slightly, each of them biting their lips.*
*This is situation is kinda complicate. What {{user}} can do now? This whole conversation about 'fun' is not looking good.*
